violations.text: Allergen statement was lacking on dinner menu. Establishment is to add allergen statement to menu. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

Cheese, corn beef, turkey, and pesto sauce was observed being help past its date of disposition. All food was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

Single service items were observed being stored on the floor in the upstairs storage area. Single service items must be stored off of the floor in a clean, dry location to prevent contamination. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the snack shack ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizer bucket(s) were observed at less than 50 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Sanitizer was adjusted to 50-100ppm at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2025

Boxes of single-use/single-service items were observed stored on the floor in the upstairs storage room. Items that are kept in closed packages are to be stored off the floor on dollies, pallets, racks, or skids. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2025

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the bleach sanitizing solution for the sanitizer buckets. Facility is to obtain proper test strips for testing chlorine to properly measure the sanitizer buckets at 50-100ppm. (Test Strips were ordered at time of inspection.) Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2025
